context.name: Context
context.label: Who uses it, and what it touches
context.blurb: 谁杀了客人？ (P1–P3 built). Every phone is a seat; one optional TV is a spectator that only ever sees public information.

nodes.name: Player
nodes.desc: Plays one seat from their own phone. Sees only their own hand, the cards shown to them, and the envelope if they accuse wrongly.

nodes.name: Host
nodes.desc: A player who also creates the room, picks the theme and max players, fills empty seats with bots and presses Start (needs 3+).

nodes.name: Living-room audience
nodes.desc: Watches the TV in 'TV + phones' mode. The TV is never a seat and never receives a hand, a shown card or the envelope.

nodes.name: Theme author
nodes.desc: Makes a new Cluedo board by adding a theme pack: a manifest, i18n strings and asset files. Writes no engine, server or client code.

nodes.name: Who Killed the Guest
nodes.desc: An online deduction game in the style of Cluedo. The server holds the state; clients only send intents. The theme (CNY family dinner) is data, not code.

nodes.name: Google Fonts
nodes.desc: Serves the typefaces each theme names in its ui.fonts tokens. For the CNY pack that is ZCOOL KuaiLe, Fredoka and Noto Serif SC 900.

edges.label: join by 4-digit code / QR · play turns
adds a theme pack · runs theme:check

containers.name: Containers
containers.label: Inside Who Killed the Guest
containers.blurb: One SPA serves both the phone and the TV view, a single Node process holds every room in memory, and theme packs are static files. The engine package is a pure library inside the server.

nodes.name: Phone client
nodes.desc: The whole game UI, from language pick to results. It keeps no game truth: it renders the latest public diff merged with its own private messages.

nodes.name: TV view
nodes.desc: Joins a room as a spectator socket. The server sends it the public projection only, so a TV bug can never leak a hand. One stage: the board stays on screen from lobby to end, with the players down the side, and the suggestion scene, dice and turn banner play over it.

nodes.name: Game server
nodes.desc: The authority for rooms, the deck, the envelope, turns, bots and timers. It validates every intent against the current stage and the seat's turn before applying it.

nodes.name: Room store
nodes.desc: Every live room keyed by its 4-digit code. A room nobody is connected to (no player, no TV) is closed after 30 min. Lost on restart; rooms survive refreshes through seat tokens.

nodes.name: Theme packs
nodes.desc: One folder per board: theme.json (deck, board grid, rules, story, ui tokens), i18n/<lang>.json and assets/. The server validates every pack at boot and serves them over HTTP.

nodes.name: theme:check CLI
nodes.desc: The same validator the server runs at boot, exposed as a CLI for theme authors. It fails on missing assets, unresolved ids, starts off the corridor, doors with no corridor next to them and missing i18n keys.

nodes.name: Google Fonts
nodes.desc: Loads the theme's fonts. The pack names them; the client never hardcodes one.

edges.label: socket.io + ack: room:create · join · resume · leave · lobby:* · intro:ready/skip · game:intent · game:pause · react · end:vote
room:state · game:events (public) + private: game:private · game:showRequest · game:shown

server.components.name: Game server
server.components.label: Inside the game server
server.components.blurb: The gateway validates the payload, the GameController orchestrates, and the engine decides. The engine is pure: applyIntent(state, intent, rng) → {state, events}, with no I/O and no theme strings.

nodes.name: Phone client
nodes.desc: One socket per human seat, bound to a seat id. A reconnect re-binds by seat token (open question).

nodes.name: TV view
nodes.desc: Joins the room's public channel only.

nodes.name: SocketGateway
nodes.desc: Parses every inbound event against the shared protocol schemas and routes it. Maps sockets to seats; room:resume re-binds a seat from its secret token after a refresh.

nodes.name: RoomManager
nodes.desc: Creates rooms, issues codes and binds sockets to seats. A room's themeId is fixed at creation so a running game can never change board.

nodes.name: LobbyService
nodes.desc: Character picking (one owner per suspect), bot fill (bots get characters after people), kick, leave, and Start. The host is the first connected person, so the role passes on if the host drops.

nodes.name: GameController
nodes.desc: The only writer of a room's game state, through the phases intro → play → end → (rematch) intro. Applies intents through the engine, re-arms or pauses the timer, schedules bots, hands events to projection.

nodes.name: GameEngine
nodes.desc: The rules: deal, envelope, BFS movement, room entry ends movement, secret passages, suggest, clockwise disprove, accuse and ghosts. It sees card ids and a compiled board graph, never names or art.

nodes.name: TurnTimer
nodes.desc: One deadline per room. Bots get the timer too, unlike the prototype where it only guarded the human.

nodes.name: BotRunner
nodes.desc: Fills empty seats. Remembers its hand and every card shown to it, walks to rooms it has not ruled out, suggests unknown cards, and accuses once one card is left per category.

nodes.name: Projection
nodes.desc: Turns state and events into three views: public room state (with suggestion history), private messages for one seat, the TV view. Who showed a card to whom is public; which card is never public.

nodes.name: ThemeRegistry
nodes.desc: Scans themes/*, validates each pack and compiles board.grid into ADJ, doors and the room-distance map. An invalid pack stops the server at boot instead of failing mid-game.

nodes.name: Room store
nodes.desc: See the containers level.

nodes.name: Theme packs
nodes.desc: See the containers level.

client.components.name: Phone client
client.components.label: Inside the phone / TV SPA
client.components.blurb: Screens read from one store and send intents through one socket. Every name, colour, picture and story line comes from the ThemeProvider by id.

nodes.name: Router
nodes.desc: Picks the phone shell or the TV shell, then the screen from the room's phase. The handoff's step bar becomes this phase switch.

nodes.name: Screens
nodes.tech: Lang · Home · Settings · Lobby · Intro · Play · End (+ TV variants)
nodes.desc: The high-fidelity screens from the handoff. They show what the server says; reachable squares come from the server too.

nodes.name: Overlays
nodes.tech: Dice · moment · sheets · tutorial · reveal · reactions
nodes.desc: Suggestion, show-a-card and accuse sheets, the 3D dice, the turn banner, the accusation moment and the floating stickers. The suggestion is paced on the client from the public events: the cards first, then each answer in turn, then who showed whom. Sticker art and labels come from theme.ui.stickers.

nodes.name: GameStore
nodes.desc: Public room state, this seat's private data and the session (seat token in sessionStorage, resumed on reload and reconnect). Notes marks stay on the device.

nodes.name: SocketClient
nodes.desc: Typed emit and listen over the shared protocol. It writes into the store and never into React state directly.

nodes.name: ThemeProvider
nodes.desc: Loads theme.json and i18n/<lang>.json, writes the ui tokens as CSS custom properties, and exposes t(key). A missing key falls back to the default language.

nodes.name: AssetResolver
nodes.desc: Maps card, token and scene ids to files in the pack. Swapping a board means new files under the same ids, not a code change.

nodes.name: Game server
nodes.desc: See the containers level.

nodes.name: Theme packs
nodes.desc: See the containers level.

nodes.name: Google Fonts
nodes.desc: Fonts named by theme.ui.fonts.

cues.title: Create room
cues.note: The host sends room:create with a name, maxPlayers 3–6, mode phones | tv, the bots toggle and a themeId.

cues.title: Pin the theme
cues.note: The themeId must match a pack that passed validation at boot. It is fixed for the room's lifetime.

cues.title: Store the room
cues.note: A free 4-digit code is chosen and the host is bound to seat 0.

cues.title: Lobby state
cues.note: The phone gets the code for Share and the QR. Other players then room:join(code) and the TV sends room:watch(code).

cues.title: Pick and start
cues.note: pickChar locks a suspect to one seat; taken ones show dimmed with the owner's name. The host's start needs 3 or more seats, with bots counted.

cues.title: TV seat cards
cues.note: The TV gets the public lobby: seats, characters and the QR. It goes into story and setup with every other screen.

cues.title: Suggest
cues.note: The seat is in a room at stage suggest and sends suggest(sus, obj). The room is implied by its position.

cues.title: Route to game
cues.note: The payload passes the zod check. The controller checks that it is this seat's turn and the right stage.

cues.title: Resolve suggestion
cues.note: The engine moves the named suspect's token into the room, then walks seats clockwise to the first one holding any of the 3 cards. Ghosts still count.

cues.title: Project the moment
cues.note: Everyone gets the suggestion moment (3 cards, then ✕ Pass / ✓ Has one per seat). The holder gets a private game:showRequest.

cues.title: Fan out
cues.note: Public to the room, private to the holder's seat only.

cues.title: Choose a card
cues.note: The holder's phone opens the show-a-card sheet. A bot holder picks through BotRunner instead.

cues.title: Show card
cues.note: showCard(card). The server checks the card is in that seat's hand and matches the trio.

cues.title: Apply showCard
cues.note: The stage moves to end. showCount[seat]++ for the Tight-lipped award.

cues.title: Split the reveal
cues.note: The suggester gets shown {card, from}. Everyone else gets only from → to.

cues.title: Emit
cues.note: Three views: the suggester's private message, the public log line and the TV view.

cues.title: TV: who showed whom
cues.note: The TV says 'A showed a card to B' and never which card.

cues.title: Accuse
cues.note: accuse(sus, room, obj), after the confirm step. Only on your own turn and only once per player.

cues.title: Route
cues.note: Refused if the seat is already out or it is not their turn.

cues.title: Check envelope
cues.note: A wrong guess sets out[seat] = true: the token turns grey and the seat is skipped, but it still shows cards. A right guess goes to reveal.

cues.title: Split the result
cues.note: The accuser gets the envelope privately. The public gets 'wrong accusation' without the guess.

cues.title: Emit
cues.note: The private message goes first, so the accuser's sheet opens before the TV announcement.

cues.title: TV announcement
cues.note: 'Wrong accusation' plus the ghost token. The guess itself is never sent.

cues.title: Arm the clock
cues.note: Every turn start arms rules.turnSeconds = 60. The ring goes red at ≤10 s on clients.

cues.title: Time's up
cues.note: No intent arrived in time, so the controller applies endTurn(seat) itself.

cues.title: Advance turn
cues.note: The next seat clockwise, skipping ghosts. The round goes up when it wraps to the first seat.

cues.title: Bot seat
cues.note: The next seat has no human, so BotRunner is scheduled with a small think delay.

cues.title: Bot intents
cues.note: roll, then move to a random reachable room (or the corridor square nearest a room), then suggest. These go through the same validation as human intents.

cues.title: Project
cues.note: Dice, the token walk path (170 ms per square on clients) and the moment.

cues.title: Broadcast
cues.note: Every phone and the TV animate the bot's turn from the same public events.

flows.name: Roll and move on a phone

cues.title: Tap Roll
cues.note: The pulsing Roll button emits roll. The client never rolls its own die.

cues.title: Send intent
cues.note: Typed by packages/protocol.

cues.title: Dice result
cues.note: room:state carries the dice, stage move and reach, computed by the server.

cues.title: Apply diff
cues.note: The store merges the diff; the dice overlay spins for ~1.3 s and lands on the value.

cues.title: Preview reach
cues.note: The board highlights the squares in reach in the theme token --color-reach; the client never computes movement itself.

cues.title: Tap a square
cues.note: move(node). The server re-checks the path. Entering a room ends movement and opens the suggestion sheet.

flows.name: Refresh and take your seat back

cues.title: Resume
cues.note: After a refresh the phone sends room:resume {code, token} with the seat token saved in sessionStorage at join time.

cues.title: Find the seat
cues.note: The token must match a human seat in that room; otherwise cannot resume and the phone forgets the session.

cues.title: Resync
cues.note: The socket is re-bound to the seat and joins the room channel again.

cues.title: Private state again
cues.note: Room state to all (seat shows connected), then to this seat only: game:private and, if it is being asked, game:showRequest.

cues.title: Back in the game
cues.note: The phone lands on the screen for the current phase: lobby, intro, play or end.
